evidence.quote: We propose a $36 million class fund distributed automatically to the approximately 400,000 identifiable members, plus up to $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
The parties discussed class relief and fees together; class relief was not agreed upon before fees were discussed.
with any reduction in the fee award going to the class.

summary: Class counsel raised fees in its opening proposal, and the parties negotiated fees and class relief together. Unawarded fees would benefit the class, linking the fee award to class recovery. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class relief for fees, defense exploiting fee interests, or a misleading declaration.
